title: Santa Monica City Council planting trees
description:
The tree planting continues in Downtown Santa Monica.
Members of the Santa Monica City Council and the Public Landscape Division joined together to plant Chinese Flame trees on Santa Monica Blvd. and Ocean Ave. this past Wednesday as part of the city's Realignment Plan.

These beautiful new trees will make an immediate impact, mirroring the mature Chinese Flame trees across the street on Santa Monica Blvd. They will shape the streetscape for generations to come.
